items.title: Frank Strazzeri interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: Yeah. I played with him for years, Chet. About 30 years I played with him. I actually buried him when he died. I had a talk over his grave out here.

ctx.x: Oh my. And you played on Chet Baker?

Yeah. I played with him for years, Chet. About 30 years I played with him. I actually buried him when he died. I had a talk over his grave out here. They buried him out here. The family brought him out here and buried him next to his father out here by the airport. And they asked me to say something over his grave. I couldn’t believe he was dead man. I had just left him in France man. We were at this chateau, this beautiful chateau, we were out there in the country man, and I remember getting on the bus going to…
